summary: We found 5 things that could be costing G Builders NYC customers, and 3 that are working well.

issues.title: Not built for phones
issues.why: Most visitors arrive on a phone. Text is tiny and buttons are hard to tap, so many leave before reading anything.
issues.fix: Rebuild the layout mobile-first, so text, buttons and forms fit any screen.

issues.title: Looks unmaintained (© 2024)
issues.why: An old year in the footer makes the business look inactive.
issues.fix: Update the content and set the year to update itself.

issues.title: No way to enquire on the page
issues.why: Interested visitors have no quick way to reach you, so many don’t.
issues.fix: Add a short enquiry form, a WhatsApp button and a clear call to action on every page.

issues.title: No search description
issues.why: Google picks random text to show under your name in results.
issues.fix: Write a short description that says what you do and why people should choose you.

issues.title: No analytics
issues.why: There’s no way to know how many people visit or where they come from.
issues.fix: Install privacy-friendly analytics so you can see what’s working.

recommendations.title: A portfolio site that wins tenders
recommendations.detail: Project pages with photos, scope and results that answer a buyer’s questions before the call.

recommendations.title: Off-plan sales pages with payment plans
recommendations.detail: One page per development, with floor plans, pricing and a way to reserve.

recommendations.title: Client progress portal with photo updates
recommendations.detail: Clients see their build move forward without chasing you for updates.
